accepted_answers.name: PyMuPDF (fitz)
accepted_answers.why: Fastest general-purpose text extraction for text-based PDFs; standard pick for high-volume pipelines (AGPL/commercial licence caveat).

accepted_answers.name: pdfplumber
accepted_answers.why: Accepted (often preferred) when tables/structured layout matter: best table extraction among permissive MIT options.

accepted_answers.name: pypdf
accepted_answers.why: Accepted lightweight MIT-licensed default for simple well-formed PDFs and page ops (merge/split).

notes: No single winner: speed -> PyMuPDF, tables -> pdfplumber, simplicity -> pypdf. Licence matters: PyMuPDF is AGPL-3.0, the others MIT/BSD. None handle scanned PDFs — those need OCR (e.g. Azure Document Intelligence, Tesseract).
problem: Extracting text from PDF files in Python (library or product choice).
